decisions.reason: As a close-to-core coding product in a growing market, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping while demand and customer adoption continue to clarify.
This piezo inkjet printer still fits the established portfolio, but its more specialized positioning leaves a somewhat higher chance of pruning than the thermal inkjet alternative.
Because this laser system line is a flagship closely tied to the firm's strategic direction, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch.
The compact laser cabin is still early enough in its market test to keep as an option, though overlap with other laser offerings makes its continuation somewhat less secure than the flagship line.
The lubricant printing system is specialized, but the award signal and fit with the firm's application-led strategy make it worth retaining while its commercial potential is further revealed.
